import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for p in [1,2]:

    # separator = full-row color; find most common color of full rows
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(I[r][0] for r in range(H) if all(x==I[r][0] for x in I[r]))

    for v in Counter(sum(I,r) for r in I).most_common(1)[0][0] if False else None: pass

    # pick color forming most separator lines
    cnts={v:(sum(r==[v]*W for r in [I[rr] for rr in range(H) if all(x==v for x in I[rr])]) + sum(all(I[r][c]==v for r in range(H)) for c in range(W)), v) for v in cand}
    best=max(cnts.items(), key=lambda t:t[1][0])[1][1]
    sep=best
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if all(I[r][c]==sep for c in range(W))]
    cs=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    def bnds(n,s):

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def regions(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    sep=None
    for v in set(x for row in I for x in row):
        if any(all(I[r][c]==v for c in range(W)) for r in range(H)): sep=v
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if all(I[r][c]==sep for c in range(W))]
    cs=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    def bnds(n,s):
        bs=[];s0=0
        for x in s+[n-1]:
            if x>=s0: bs.append((s0,x)); s0=x+1
        return bs
    rb=bnds(H,rs); cb=bnds(W,cs)
    grid=defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=I[r][c]
            if v!=0 and v!=sep:
                rr=next(x for x in rb if x[0]<=r<=x[1]); cc=next(x for x in cb if x[0]<=c<=x[1])
                # use band start indices (not absolute coords) for key
                ri=rb.index(rr); ci=cb.index(cc)
                grid[v][(ri,ci)].append((r-rr[0],c-cb[0]+(cc-None)))
    return sep,rb,cb,grid

# Careful: store (band_index, cells_rel_to_band_start) 
def analyze(p):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    sep=None
    for v in set(x for row in I for x in row):
        if any(all(I[r][c]==v for c in range(W)) for r in range(H)): sep=v
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if all(I[r][c]==sep for c in range(W))]
    cs=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    rb=[(s,e) for s,e in zip([0]+[x+1 for x in rs], [x for x in rs]+[H]) if e>s]
    cb=[(s,e) for s,e in zip([0]+[x+1 for x in cs], [x for x in cs]+[W]) if e>s]
    items=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=I[r][c]
            if v!=0 and v!=sep:
                rr=next(x for x in rb if x[0]<=r<=x[1]); cc=next(x for x in cb if x[0]<=c<=x[1])
                items.append((rr,cc,v,(r-rr[0],c-cb.index(cc))))
    added=[(i,j,O[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j]]
    res={'inp':items,'added':added}
    return res

for p in [1,2]:

        shapes[(rr,cc)].add((v,off))

    print('added:',sorted(d['added']))

G=load()
from collections import Counter
def analyze(p):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H=len(gi);W=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter()
    for v in set(x for row in gi for x in row):
        rfull=sum(1 for r in range(H) if all(x==v for x in gi[r]))
        cfull=sum(1 for c in range(W) if all(gi[r][c]==v for r in range(H)))
        cnt[v]+=rfull+cfull
    sep=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==sep for x in gi[r])]
    cs=[c for c in range(W) if all(gi[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    def make(lines,n):
        b=[];s=0
        for e in lines+[n]:
            if s<=e-1: b.append((s,e-1)); s=e+1
        return b
    rb=make(rs,H);cb=make(cs,W)
    # attach leftovers
    while sum(end-start+1 for _,_ in rb)+sum(e-s for s,e in rs or [])!=H:
        pass
    # easier: recompute using known spacing; instead just rebuild by snapping leftovers to adjacent bands
    if rb:
        if sum(1 for _,_ in rb)*max(len(range(b[0][0],b[0][1]+1)) for b in rb)*0: pass
    return sep,rs,cs,rb,cb,gi,go,H,W
for p in [1,2]:
    s,rs,cs,rb,cb,gi,go,H,W=analyze(p)
    print('demo',p,'sep',s,'H,W',H,W,'rb',rb,'cb',cb,'rowsum',sum(r2-r1-1+1 for r1,r2 in rb),len(gi), len([r for r in range(H) if not any(gi[r][c]!=s for c in range(W))]))
